parsed.why: No criminalisation since 2008, but official reports place trans women as most-targeted with state police among aggressors, unreported attacks, cultural acceptance of violence and post-2018 impunity — state-tolerated hostility with no working recourse.

Sodomy law upheld in 2024 and documented reaching gender-nonconforming people: trans woman convicted to eight years in a men's prison, police arrests and assaults of trans people, medical denial, moratorium annulled, high-level incitement.

Self-declaration recognition, 2024 hate-crime law covering gender identity, open LGBT scenes, official apologies, high public support. No documented visitor-facing restriction; resident care waits and rising prejudice are friction, not traveller exposure.

Sex outside heterosexual marriage criminalised with lashing and death penalty, documented executions, mass raids with threatened execution, custodial rape and forced tests, official advisory banning trans presence from busy areas, no protections.

Decriminalised 2021 and no identity offence, but trans people four times likelier to be assaulted, police dismiss complaints over male markers, impunity for anti-trans violence, no anti-discrimination law or working remedy; social invisibility rather than persecution.
